steps.title: Select characters
steps.text: Each player chooses a character and takes the matching token, color, and cards.

steps.title: Create the case file
steps.text: Shuffle suspects, weapons, and rooms separately; place one from each into the case file envelope without revealing.

steps.title: Deal remaining cards
steps.text: Shuffle the remaining cards together and deal them evenly to all players.
Roll the die and move your token that many spaces, or use a secret passage if available.
If you are in a room, make a suggestion naming a suspect, weapon, and room.
The next player to your left who can disprove must show you one matching card in secret.
Make an accusation at any time on your turn. If correct, you win; if wrong, you are out.
